title: RoomKG Baselines: symbolic and neural agents for the RoomKG Benchmark
description:
Baseline agent implementations, training and evaluation code, and per-seed raw results accompanying the paper A Neurosymbolic Benchmark for Temporal Knowledge-Graph Memory in Partially Observable Environments.

The repository contains two symbolic agents (a plain knowledge-graph agent and a temporal knowledge-graph agent whose stored statements carry :time_added, :last_accessed and :num_recalled annotations), LSTM and Transformer neural baselines trained with a DQN objective, the plotting code for the reported figures, and the aggregated and per-seed results behind them.

The benchmark environment itself is released separately as room-env.
